what_this_is: The hand-kept half of the weekly adoption count: implementations written by people who do not work for this project that reproduced our bytes or verdicts. Each row names one public place where the reproduction can be read. Each row has a kind: implementation (code of the author's own that reproduced our bytes or verdicts), reproduction (a rerun of our own code that matched) or integration (our vectors or records taken into someone else's tests or mapping). Only implementations feed the implementation count; the other kinds are reported apart. tools/adoption/count_adoption.py checks every link still answers and counts the rows; it adds nothing by itself. Add a row only with a link a stranger can open.

implementations.subject: a2a-card-sign-v01

open_calls.nenrin-provenance: A NENRIN provenance verifier by a further author, in any language, that reproduces the verdict signatures of interop-v0, interop-v0.1 and interop-v0.2/edge. Two so far, both by kuangmi-bit: workers/hs-ledger/nenrin/interop-v0/INTEROP.md
open_calls.nenrin-interop-v0.3-survivors: Point any NENRIN provenance verifier, in any language, at the nine survivors vectors and post the result: npx nenrin-tsunagi run nenrin-interop-v0.3-survivors -- "<your verifier command> {in} {out}". The reference takes one command after npm install nenrin-verify@0.5.2 (papers/nenrin-stack/README.md, section Rerun it from outside; replication package doi:10.5281/zenodo.23344510)
